description:
FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER

Ivy One, an Interplay Studio company

 

LOCATION

New York, NY

Hybrid: in our office 2–3 days a week, plus time on site with clients

 

ABOUT IVY ONE

Ivy One is the AI operator for family offices and investment funds. An Interplay Studio company based in New York, Ivy One delivers the product, platform and services that help family offices use AI in the best, safest and most practical way.

 

THE ROLE

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll work hands-on with family offices and investment funds to embed Ivy into their setup. You’ll connect it to their systems, build the custom integrations and workflows each firm needs, and make sure every client is live and getting real value within 90 days.

You’ll work with a few clients at a time, each for roughly 3 to 6 months: on site for kickoffs and working sessions, and from our office the rest of the time. You’ll report to our CEO and work closely with our Head of Product Engineering.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead technical onboarding for new clients, from kickoff to go-live.

 - Work directly with principals, CFOs and operations teams to learn how each firm runs.

 - Connect Ivy to each firm’s tools: Microsoft 365, portfolio systems such as Addepar, CRMs, data rooms and bank portals.

 - Build custom integrations, document workflows and protocols: the repeatable work Ivy runs for each firm.

 - Check your work like the numbers matter, and follow our security and privacy practices on every build.

 - Support sales with demos and scoping, and bring what you learn back into the platform.



WHO YOU ARE

 - An engineer who has shipped software real people depend on.

 - An owner: open and honest, the first to flag a problem and the first to fix it.

 - A clear communicator who can explain technical tradeoffs in plain English.

 - Careful by default. For these clients, a wrong number or a privacy slip costs trust you don’t get back.

 - A focused team player who likes to be challenged and challenges back.



REQUIRED SKILLS

 - 1–3 years of professional software engineering experience.

 - Strong Python and/or TypeScript, and solid SQL.

 - Experience integrating third-party APIs and working with messy real-world data.

 - Hands-on experience building with LLMs.

 - Experience working directly with customers or non-technical stakeholders.

 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - U.S. work authorization, and willingness to complete a background check.



NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in a forward deployed, solutions or implementation engineering role, or at an early-stage startup.

 - Microsoft 365 / Graph APIs, PDF data extraction, or building agents.

 - AWS (especially Amazon Bedrock), Next.js, Vercel and Supabase.

 - Daily use of Claude Code, Cursor or similar AI coding tools.

 - Exposure to wealth management, private equity or fintech.

 

COMPENSATION

$85–100k base salary, commensurate with experience

Competitive health benefits
